module_mood_contract: learning through contrast — 'I can feel what packaging adds now; I couldn't have read it as a lecture.' Pre-read function: prime the diagnostic lens and plant the question without resolving it. Mood at pre-read close: curious and primed, 8/10.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures are closers, not openers.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a meta-frame lecture (doesn't name a pattern the student just lived through in this module). It is vocabulary-introduction placed exactly where the vocab earns itself: it primes three failure-mode names against an artefact the student already produced (M4's un-packaged send-off), immediately before M5 Phase 1 applies those exact names (diagnose-and-resend.md: 'walk the work through three failure-mode lenses with quoted moments'). Placement diagnostic (naming a pattern / showing a ceiling / teaching vocabulary) resolves to 'teaching vocabulary,' correctly mid-arc.

Carries spirit (the diagnostic question) + three failure-mode lenses + one practitioner anchor (Ronacher, described but unresolved) + one mechanism explanation (§3 'Why these three, every run' — why the failures are statistical-machine consequences, not why one fix beats another). Does NOT carry: the three-pattern fix, the practitioner name for the solution, an operational primitive (that's `learning-through-contrast.md`'s job per its own maintainer note: 'Don't expand the three-lens explanation. The pre-read carries depth; the opener restates for the room.'). §3's mechanism content is diagnostic/epistemic (why the failures are inevitable) not prescriptive (how to fix them), so it arms the read rather than teaching the fix. Within dosage ceiling.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero `M[0-9]` or module-name refs above the maintainer fence (grep confirms). Maintainer block documents a 2026-07-02 sweep that moved 'What to bring to M5' out to `run-the-first-experiment.md § Bring to Module 5` and cut the 'M5 opens with...' closer entirely. Remaining map-position phrases ('the Work phase', 'the far half') are spine-anchors under the rule's own carve-out, not sequencing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test AND the truth clause.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Four headers, each names the one thing: 'What would have caught this earlier?' (the diagnostic question), 'Three failure modes you'll use to read' (named lenses), 'Why these three, every run' (the law-claim the body argues), "Ronacher's ten-hour port surfaced all three" (the anchor case). No empty containers, no orphan mystery, no orientation-only headers, no two headers alike — squint passes. Truth clause: each header's claim is exactly what the body underneath supports, no unsupported universals or dropped qualifiers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded (~210 words / ≤6 bullets per ##).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Per-section word/bullet counts, well under the 210-word / 6-bullet ceiling on all four: §1 ~118w/3 bullets, §2 ~173w/4 bullets, §3 ~140w/4 bullets, §4 ~95w/3 bullets. Maintainer block's own total (~410 words body) spread over 4 slides confirms no section is oversized.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This file has zero fenced prompt blocks (pure lecture). The actual forcing function — 'walk the work through three failure-mode lenses with quoted moments' — correctly lives in M5's `diagnose-and-resend.md` Phase 1 prompt (`{{prompt:diagnose-and-resend-2}}`), not paraphrased away as body prose here. This file only plants vocabulary; it doesn't narrate or substitute for the downstream forcing function.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body teaches the work; trainer manages the room outside text.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No authored conversation cues anywhere in the body — no 'share with your neighbor,' no 'take 90 seconds,' no pause-cue sentences. Every sentence is about the artefact, the three lenses, or the Ronacher anchor. File is short enough (~410w, ~5 min) that dual-mode delivery (pre-read + in-room silent projection read) needs no authored trainer cue.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named and lands per beat; mood-floor applies to teaching beats.
rules_evaluated.evidence: trace.phases[1].mood_score=8 (both pre-read and in-room modes), trace.close.mood_score=8. Single-phase file (no ## Phase headers); whole body is one TEACHING beat (plants failure-mode vocabulary + the diagnostic question that M5 will apply) so the 8+/10 mood-floor applies and is met, not the setup-beat exemption.

Framing throughout is diagnostic-curious ('what would have caught this earlier?'), never blame-shaped. Matches the exercise it feeds — `diagnose-and-resend.md` Phase 1 states explicitly 'What came back is data, not blame,' and this pre-read's tone is consistent with that register (failure modes named as machine consequences in §3, not student errors).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File title ('Reading the return') and its lead section name the discipline (the diagnostic read, driven by 'what would have caught this earlier?') before the three failure modes appear. The failure modes are introduced explicitly as 'the lens for the read' (§2's lead bullet) — instrumentation for the discipline, not the headline it's named for.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity — consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, and mood-doesn't-resolve-early into one verdict.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Front-run check: three-pattern (reference/plan.md/verifier) is named nowhere in the file — confirmed by direct read and by the maintainer's own watch-for ('Don't pre-empt the three-pattern'). Module-to-module arc: M4 (`run-the-first-experiment.md`) hands off directly ('Before you close: read Reading the return... Bring the three failure modes... as your reading lens'); M5 (`learn-from-the-test.md § Start here`) picks it up ('You walk in with the artefact... and the three failure-mode lenses in hand. The in-room lecture below opens the session' + direct link) — clean bidirectional wiring, verified via grep of both module files. Big Idea fidelity: M5's Big Idea ('Read the un-packaged Module 4 run through three failure-mode lenses, build the validation that would have caught each') is honored exactly through the lenses + question delivered here, without delivering the 'build the validation' part. Mood-doesn't-resolve-early: the Ronacher resolution is explicitly withheld ('What that was is where your own read leads') and the three-pattern stays unnamed — M5's teaching moment is protected.

mood_summary.teaching_moment_lands: PASS (no check_strategy_tie_in row per template — recorded here). Three failure-mode names + the diagnostic question reliably land across pre-read and in-room modes (trace shows convergence within ~3 min for both reader types). Reliability is confirmed downstream, not asserted: M5 Phase 1's own forcing function (`diagnose-and-resend.md`, `{{prompt:diagnose-and-resend-2}}`) reuses the exact three names with zero re-explanation, and the module's own 'Failure-mode collapse' watch-for exists specifically to catch a student who blurs two of the three lenses this file plants — evidence the vocabulary is expected to have landed cleanly by the time Phase 1 fires.
